name: @veltravia/codebase-mock
description: Deterministic OFFLINE implementation of the Codebase Intelligence persistence and source-provider ports (Step 16): an in-memory CodebaseIndexRepository plus a fixture SourceProvider over a plain in-memory file map. No host code, no host filesystem access, no OS isolation claimed - it exists so the core analysis engine, the API, and the web UI can be exercised end to end deterministically.
